rationale: Accept after rechecking all revised assignments. Both KO/WT brain-to-plasma AUC ratio-of-ratios now map to `brain_to_plasma_auc_ratio_knockout_to_wild_type_ratio`, and the CsA-induced maternal ratio change maps separately; ordinary AUC ratios and combined AUC/Cmax fields remain distinct.

Accept after rechecking the revised assignment. `brain-to-plasma KO/WT exposure enhancement ratio` now maps to a genotype ratio-of-ratios endpoint instead of ordinary brain/plasma exposure, with the other measurement-basis splits unchanged.

Accept after rechecking all 28 revised assignments. KO/WT ratio-of-ratios, combined brain concentration plus ratio fields, combined brain/CSF ratios, and direction-unspecified `between`/`and` wordings are now separated from literal brain-over-plasma ratios without changing AUC, Cmax, total, or Kp branches.

The revised KO/WT ratio-of-ratios and combined brain-level/brain-serum field are corrected, but `ratio of the bilirubin contents of the brain and serum` remains forced into `brain_to_serum_ratio`. The source states a ratio of two matrices without identifying numerator direction, so the complete decision still does not preserve direction.

Independent inspection of all 3 owned raw value(s) supports accepting this split. The mapping to `brain_tumor_distribution_coefficient`, `brain_tumor_ecf_to_unbound_plasma_auc_ratio`, `brain_tumor_to_unbound_plasma_auc_ratio` follows the literal matrix, binding state, measurement basis, and numerator/denominator direction without adding unsupported detail.

Accept after rechecking all revised assignments. `brain concentration; unbound brain concentration` now maps to an explicit combined endpoint, while ordinary unbound brain concentration and unbound brain Cmax remain separate.
Accept after rechecking all 14 assignments. `Cmax; Te` now maps to `cmax_and_te`; the other plain and combined Cmax, trough, CSF/plasma, and AUC fields retain their literal structures.

Independent inspection of all 34 owned raw value(s) supports accepting this split. The revised trough, cross-matrix, and multi-CSF-compartment assignments are supported, but `max CSF concentration` remains in generic `csf_concentration` while equivalent maximum/peak raws map to `csf_cmax`. This remaining raw still loses explicit Cmax point type.

Independent inspection of all 128 owned raw value(s) supports accepting this split. The mapping to `csf_to_blood_ratio`, `csf_to_serum_ratio` follows the literal matrix, binding state, measurement basis, and numerator/denominator direction without adding unsupported detail.

The concentration-or-AUC alternative is now correctly separated, but total-plasma AUC handling remains inconsistent. `AUC_CSF to total tiagabine AUC_plasma ratio` is left in generic `csf_to_plasma_auc_ratio` despite an explicit `csf_to_total_plasma_auc_ratio` branch; `CSF/plasma AUC0-12 ratio (total)` is likewise not reconciled with its case-equivalent total branch.

Accept after rechecking the revised assignments. The two combined CSF/plasma plus brain/plasma fields now have a combined endpoint, and all 19 numerator-direction-ambiguous `between`/`and` ratio wordings are separated from explicit CSF-over-plasma ratios.

The explicit `CSF/total-serum AUC∞ ratio` is now in the total-serum branch, but direction-ambiguous raws such as `ratio between CSF and serum AUC0-12`, `ratio of AUC in CSF and serum`, and `ratio of the AUCs in CSF and serum` remain forced into `csf_to_serum_auc_ratio`. Direction is therefore still not fully preserved.
